data.description:
## Description

**What**: Update /dso:doctor's skill-registry audit logic to recognize the new structure introduced by this epic: skills/onboarding/phases/<phase>.md as expected location for phase files; skills/onboarding/prompts/<topic>.md as expected location for topic prompt files. Do not flag these as orphan, invalid, or unrecognized.

**Why**: The cross-epic interaction scan flagged /dso:doctor (epic d97a-6bb7) as needing awareness of the consolidated structure. /dso:doctor likely enumerates plugins/dso/skills/*/SKILL.md and may treat phases/ and prompts/ subdirectories as anomalies. Without this update, /dso:doctor produces false-positive audit findings on the new structure.

**Scope**:
- IN: Read /dso:doctor's current audit logic; identify enumeration patterns that touch plugins/dso/skills/; update logic to whitelist phases/<phase>.md and prompts/<topic>.md as recognized structure under skills/onboarding/. Verify by running /dso:doctor against the consolidated plugin and confirming no false-positive findings.
- OUT: Broader /dso:doctor enhancements outside the onboarding-structure recognition (the parent epic d97a-6bb7 covers those).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, /dso:doctor invocation against the consolidated plugin produces no false-positive findings related to skills/onboarding/phases/ or skills/onboarding/prompts/ subdirectories
  ← Satisfies: cross-epic constraint with d97a-6bb7 (skill registry audit must recognize new structure).

## Considerations

- [Reliability] If /dso:doctor's audit logic is not yet implemented (epic d97a-6bb7 may not have shipped), record this scope as a follow-on note in d97a-6bb7's spec rather than implementing speculative integration. Coordinate with d97a-6bb7's owner before adding code.
- [Maintainability] The consolidated structure (phases/, prompts/) becomes a documented expectation that /dso:doctor checks for — coordinate the structure expectation in /dso:doctor's spec with this epic's S0 contract doc.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, /dso:doctor recognizes the consolidated /dso:onboarding structure (phases/ + prompts/) without producing false-positive audit findings
